sloka: राजा च कृतकार्यः स्यात् अहम् दीर्घ आयुः अव्ययः ।स्वर्ग लोकम् उपाश्नीयाम् तपः तप्त्वा हि अनुत्तमम् ॥१-६२-६॥
transliteration: rājā ca kṛtakāryaḥ syāt aham dīrgha āyuḥ avyayaḥ ।svarga lokam upāśnīyām tapaḥ taptvā hi anuttamam ॥1-62-6॥

translations.english: O Best among ascetics you are the protecor of everybody. You are promoter of others' welfare. May the king fulfil his purpose. May I live long and become immortal and attain heaven after performing great penance. May I enjoy heaven.
translations.hindi: हम उनका अपमान कैसे कर सकते हैं | उनके ऐसे क्रोधयुक्तः बचन सुन,
